patch_description: Crossover of the current best program (incremental area updates, best-of-K batched moves, warm starts, two-phase search with crossover merging, time budget 9s) with the inspiration script (deterministic structured seeds, perpendicular-direction guided moves that push worst-triangle vertices directly away from the opposite edge). The hybrid adds a cheap guided candidate — moving the worst triplet's vertices along perpendicular directions — into each local-search iteration alongside the batched random best-of-K moves, dramatically improving local optimum quality per iteration. It also imports the inspiration's symmetric seed layouts as extra warm starts. Deterministic seeding is preserved; incremental area vector updates are retained for speed; fallback handling ensures a valid 11-point output even on failure.
